_comment: Issue #1096/#1119: a plain NORMAL-stance MOVE order now carries Order.Guard.ENGAGED_FRACTION_ABOVE, cancelling the order outright once >=10% of the unit's own soldiers are melee-engaged, rather than letting the redirect march proceed (the old behavior would have the unit eventually break free of the fight and resume toward the now-stale destination). Stages a lone player Spearmen unit given an explicit ATTACK order against a weak Infantry detachment; once heavily engaged (tick 134), the player is redirected far off to the side with a plain move order (tick 145). Under the fix the redirect order is retired the very next tick (current_order/order_guard drop to null) instead of being accepted -- the unit never budges toward the new destination for the rest of the fight.
